verdict.rationale: PostHog documents plain-English operation across several surfaces. PostHog AI in the app answers questions and also does the work: it queries data, writes SQL, and creates dashboards, surveys, alerts and feature flags. The @PostHog Slack bot takes natural-language requests for data questions and code tasks. The hosted MCP server, confirmed live by probe, lets agents act from plain-text prompts. One hands-on user report says the in-app assistant refused to create a SQL-based cohort and slowed the UI to under 1 fps after two prompts; this is a real caveat but does not contradict the documented capabilities. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that natural-language commands work reliably in practice, assistant performance and coverage gaps (the cohort creation report), and a stable non-beta Slack surface.
